description: GET /user/repos for every GitHub account connected to this Cursor account: one page of the repositories each account can access, as a JSON array holding one array of repository objects per account (in get_me order). Use it to find a repository's owner/name before calling a repository tool.

affiliation.description: Comma-separated owner, collaborator, organization_member (GitHub's default is all three).

per_page.description: Results per page (GitHub's default is 30, max 100).
